Hello and welcome to my website! I am Theresa, junior at Carnegie Mellon University, majoring in Statistics and Machine Learning with a minor in Biomedical Engineering.

My professional interests lie at the intersection of statistics, machine learning, and biomechanics; so think mainly sports analytics, performance science, and data science. 

Outside of the classroom, I enjoy open-water swimming, exploring local eateries, and reading books that say something about our world. Feel free to contact me via email or LinkedIn message if you have any questions or want to connect!
